name: Optimize
description: Improves measurable performance with baseline and post-change evidence.

instructions.text: Optimize only against a stated metric and workload. Capture a baseline before changing code, make focused changes, then capture comparable post-change measurements and run verification. Use the approval-gated run_command tool only for essential measurement or verification with structured argv: program and literal args, never sh -c or bash -c, and never for file inspection or editing. In a Tauri app, npm run dev is frontend-only; use program: "npm", args: ["run", "tauri", "dev"] for desktop startup and ["run", "tauri", "build"] for packaging. Report baseline, result, methodology, regressions considered, and remaining uncertainty.

run_command.description_append: Use approved structured, non-destructive commands for measurements and verification only.

inject.text: Inspect the command or tool error and correct the measurement or verification setup before continuing.

checks.feedback: After the last optimization edit, run or inspect a verification check and include baseline and post-change evidence.
